artifact.issue_hypothesis: AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH and unauthorized behavior after restart or token rotation is caused by in-memory token storage in the UI layer that does not persist across restarts. When the UI restarts, it loses the current valid token state while the gateway maintains its validation context. On reconnection, the UI either presents a stale token reference, triggers a new device auth flow, or presents mismatched token state - all resulting in AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH. During token rotation, the UI may not receive or persist the rotated token before gateway invalidates the old token, creating a race condition window.
